decision: held: three of the four declared syntheses (38243785 fatigue/cognition, 35091276 oxidative/inflammatory markers, 32755613 cardiometabolic markers) are subscription-only with no open full text, so their doses, populations and outcomes cannot be verified; the one open source (34578794, skin) pools oral arms with co-interventions and is approved without credit. The record also declares no health-goal claim to match.
summary: 34578794 (8 pooled oral RCTs, astaxanthin 2-12 mg/day for 4-16 weeks in healthy adults) showed better skin moisture and elasticity but no wrinkle-depth change; the pool includes tocotrienol and collagen co-interventions and commercially linked trials, so it cannot credit astaxanthin alone. The other three meta-analyses are abstract-only. Dr. Pham's rejection of brand-wide transfer is retained; the record stays held.

identity.preparation: Oral astaxanthin capsules/softgels in canola, rice bran or MCT oil; some arms combined with tocotrienol or collagen hydrolysate

population.description: Healthy adults aged 20-65 in Japan, US, South Korea and Thailand, mostly women, some with dry skin or facial wrinkles; 8 oral RCTs pooled (Table 1).

study_contexts.study_design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 9 randomized controlled oral studies (8 pooled; 6 double-blind placebo-controlled) plus 2-3 open-label topical/oral-topical studies analysed separately; values digitized from figures.

outcomes.name: Oral ASX vs placebo: skin moisture SMD 0.53 (95% CI 0.05-1.01), I2 52%

limitations: Pooled oral arms include co-interventions (astaxanthin with tocotrienol in Yamashita 2002, with collagen hydrolysate in Yoon 2014) and active rose-hip comparators; the pool cannot be attributed to astaxanthin alone, so it is not scoring eligible.
Several trials were conducted or funded by commercial entities (Risk of bias section); data extracted with GetData Graph Digitizer; small samples.
Topical and oral-plus-topical open-label studies excluded from this oral context.
Cosmetic skin parameters only; the record declares no health-goal claim and no disease or longevity inference follows.
Returned decision: Source-content hold; reject both brand-wide transfer and “preclinical only” classification by key.
